package.name: go2_piper_joy_teleop
package.description: Joystick teleop for the Piper arm (via joint_command, real-hardware 7-element JointState shape) and the Go2 chassis (via cmd_vel), switching between them by holding a mode button. Replaces joy_to_piper_joint_states (renamed -- that name/topic was misleading, and it only drove Piper).
